Area.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/2] The interview followed an interview guide consisting of the following sections: an unstructured discussion of the events leading to the death of the farmer; sociodemographic questions about the farmer; circumstances of death; history of, and exposure to, suicidal behavior; and medical and psychiatric history.
